title: Wigner-Eckart Factorization of the Polyatomic Boltzmann Collision Operator
summary: We extend the Wigner-Eckart factorization of the spectral Boltzmann collision operator to polyatomic gases with continuous internal energy. Because internal energies are invariant under spatial rotations, the SO(3) reduction survives the Borgnakke-Larsen energy exchange, and the twelve-dimensional collision integral collapses onto a nine-dimensional kinematic core. The core splits into a sparse geometric tensor, evaluated exactly, and a dense physical tensor, integrated by singularity-resolving Gauss rules with an auxiliary Laplace representation of the fractional energy couplings.
